entry.title: Scratchivision Digital Vinyl System 1.0.0
entry.summary: Scratch samples on your MPC with a turntable. Scratchivision decodes Serato-style control vinyl (or MWM Phase) from the track input and plays your sample at the record's speed and direction. No laptop needed. ## What's in 1.0.0 - **Timecode decoding**: Serato CV02 side A at 33 or 45, and MWM Phase. A SWAP button fixes crossed L/R wiring. - **Liv
